text:
Every time she tests you, you react to your childhood.

She pulls back. You chase. She questions you. You defend like your parent is in the room.

Those reactions are muscle memory. Your parent taught you love was unpredictable. You had to prove your worth. When a woman echoes that, the old code fires.

Forgive your parent. Not because they deserve it. Because you deserve to be free.

Once you do, her tests stop triggering you. You see her behavior as information about her, not a referendum on you. Unbothered.

Free your past. Win your future.
caption:
The woman isn't the problem. Your unhealed wounds are. Send this to a man who needs it today.
